name: GOOUUU ESP32-S3-CAM V1.5
reference: Verified on GOOUUU V1.5 N16R8 / OV2640: decoded 320x240 JPEG frames and viewer lifecycle, including wall USB power. XCLK 8 MHz; 20 MHz stalled transport on this board. Other revisions require checking their schematic. Compare https://github.com/Zhuwenqian/ESP32_S3_Camera_Monitor and https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/issues/5834.
